drivers.title: Ukraine Passes Law to Legalize and Tax Its Crypto Market From July 2027
drivers.detail: The law taxes crypto profits at 18% plus a 5% military levy, cuts the rate for older holdings and puts stablecoins under the central bank. (Decrypt, The Block, Cointelegraph are covering it.)

drivers.title: Nvidia agrees to $290 million settlement over crypto mining disclosures amid Jensen Huang turmoil
drivers.detail: Nvidia agreed to a $290M settlement over claims it misled investors about crypto mining demand driving 2017–18 gaming GPU sales. (The Block, Cointelegraph are covering it.)
drivers.assets: Crypto, Tech and chip stocks, Oil, energy stocks

drivers.title: Elon Musk’s X Wins Court Judgment Against Alleged Bitcoin Bot Farm Operators
drivers.detail: London’s High Court entered a default judgment against Vivek Kumar Sen and Zamyang Sherpa after they failed to respond, though damages, which X estimates at over £207,000, won’t be set until a later hearing. (Decrypt, The Block are covering it.)

drivers.title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization

drivers.title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
